about_the_game:
Are you ready to find 500 adorable cats lost in Picasso’s cubic world? Explore 5 unique maps filled with cubic shapes, abstract forms, and uniquely hand-drawn scenes. Discover cats hiding in these scenes and color each one by numbers to bring this magical world of modern art to life!

Each map reflects Picasso’s iconic cubic style with detailed hand drawings. Can you find the cats hidden in this extraordinary world?

🎨 After finding them, color each scene only by numbers. Feel the energy of colors and cubic art in this unique world!

✨ Features:

🔷 5 unique cubic art maps

🐱 500 hidden cats in total

🎨 Paint-by-numbers system

🧘‍♀️ Relaxed gameplay without time pressure

🎧 Special themed cubic art radio broadcast

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play online duo with a friend
